label: late copy-phase steps, boosted by v/c/3/s/x
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99.8% of activation mass), essentially never on original-phase or <DEL> steps. Rate climbs with position in the copy: ~2% at recall_idx 1, 18% at 3, 35-46% at 4-7, 58% at 8, and it is more active for longer sequences (L=9). Token identity modulates it strongly: steps whose input/output is v, c, 3, s or x have the highest rates (out_tok 3 rate 0.60, v 0.47), and the top activations (up to 0.70) are runs of v/c/3 in late copy steps. Sequences without these tokens (e.g. mostly 0/1/2, w, r, q) often stay silent even late in the copy. Copy phase & recall_idx>=3 alone gives F1 0.49 (mass recall 0.96); adding requirement that the sequence contains one of v/c/3/s/x gives F1 0.55 (mass 0.88). Precision stays low (~0.4) because the feature is only on in a fraction of eligible late-copy steps, so the description is incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: 3, v, d, q, b, x; least: a, o, n, 0) and the current input token, by step (t=15: v, c, s, 3; t=13: v, c, 3, s; t=11: v, c, s, 3); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, L=8 & t=7, L=9.
